SwapFrequency.description:
Number of coupon payments per year for the underlying swap in HW1F calibration.

USD swaps are semi-annual (2), EUR swaps are annual (1).

description: Settings of the piecewise-constant Hull-White sigma bootstrap to cap/floor quotes.

fit_tolerance.description:
Required positive maximum implied-normal-volatility error in decimal rate units.
Cap/floor quotes use the normal (Bachelier) convention only.
This acceptance budget is independent of the numerical solver tolerance.

fixed_kappa.description: Mean reversion held fixed while bootstrapping the volatility schedule.

frequency.description: Synthetic coupon frequency used only when contractual schedules are absent.

sigma_max.description: Inclusive upper short-rate volatility search bound.

sigma_min.description: Inclusive lower short-rate volatility search bound.
